$comment: Semgrep findings reviewed and accepted as false positives (scripts/semgrep-report.mjs). One entry per rule and file, with the reason. Add an entry only in a reviewed pull request; fix real findings instead.

accepted.reason: `createCipher` here is @synan/db's own field-cipher factory (AES-256-GCM with a random 12-byte IV per value), not Node's deprecated crypto.createCipher.
Same: @synan/db's createCipher factory, not Node's deprecated crypto.createCipher.

The tag passed to setAuthTag is always the last 16 bytes of a value checked to be at least 16 bytes, so a short tag cannot be supplied. Hardening suggested to the crypto owner: pass { authTagLength: 16 } to createDecipheriv.
The tag is sliced as exactly 16 bytes from each frame. Same hardening suggestion: { authTagLength: 16 }.
The rule matches a doc comment naming the plain WebSocket scheme; the code derives the scheme from the API origin (http -> ws, https -> wss), so an https API gets wss.
